summary: Orion Digital Corp. filed Form 6-K with unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow data in Canadian dollars, showing total assets of CAD 166.6M, net loss of CAD 5.8M, and basic EPS of (CAD 0.21). No special-situation event — only routine quarterly reporting, equivalent to a domestic 10-Q filing. No deal terms, activist activity, or strategic event is present.
